marker.note: Tauri's NSIS/MSI bundlers patch one 3-byte bundle-type marker ('UNK' -> 'NSS' / 'MSI') into their embedded copy of the executable. Every other byte is identical to the portable executable, so the recorded digests differ while the installed programs are the same build.

functionalNote: Each installed payload was launched from its extracted bytes with the WebView2 debugger and evaluated over CDP: the record names the observed navigation-button count, the managed-control text and the rendered body length. The in-sandbox lifecycle legs install the SAME payload bytes (their recorded installed digest equals nsisPayload.sha256 / msiPayload.sha256) and prove install, launch, version identity, uninstall and preservation; this probe proves the functional shell of those exact bytes.
